notes:
I found one pick I could back with the venue's own page.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Montréal Science Centre (Old Port of Montréal)",
      "age_fit": "Family venue with hands-on exhibits. No toddler age range was posted on the pages I read.",
      "when": "Regular hours on its visitor-info page: Sat-Sun 10am-5pm, Mon-Fri 9am-4pm. That is Sun Dec 27 10-5 and Mon-Wed Dec 28-30 9-4. I could not confirm its holiday hours for Dec 27-30, 2026.",
      "source_name": "Montréal Science Centre"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Hours:** 
The Science Centre's own visitor page lists Monday through Friday 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., and Saturday and Sunday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.

- **Holiday hours:** The holiday-hours page I found is an old one. 
It says the centre was open 10am to 6pm from December 26 to 30
, but it is more than 1,000 days old, so I did not use it for this year.
- **IMAX:** 
The ticket page says IMAX runs Monday to Friday for now and returns to a regular schedule during the holiday season.

- **Price:** No price was posted on the pages I read, so I left it out.

**Biodôme and Insectarium:** I left these out. Their hours came only from listing and review sites, not from their own pages. Those listings suggest regular hours of Tuesday to Sunday, 9am to 5pm, with Mondays closed. 
A Montréal tourism page says all Espace pour la vie museums are closed December 24 and 25.
 I could not confirm hours for Dec 27-30 from the venues' own site.

**Playgrounds and toddler play spaces:** I ran out of searches before I could look for these, so there is nothing for them yet.
